decision: ADR-035; user authorized TASK-034 and a documented SimFire adequacy audit before considering CA
observation: unchanged current 4x16x16 grid, previous weather, time, budget and legal action mask; no terrain, ID, future weather or future states as policy features

nested_directional_rbf.features: original28 plus per-sector front mass, front extent, fuel mean and front-weighted fuel; near/far fuel in forward cone (48 features)

nested_full_grid_rbf.features: all current grid pixels flattened plus weather/time/budget (1031 values)

fit: backward fitted Q; four time-specific models; mean-centered targets; fit-only standardization; RBF squared distances divided by fit-only median positive squared distance; exp(-distance/(2*bandwidth^2)); alpha positive; known no-intervention zero-gain floor on wait
evaluation: outer leave-one-fire-out; deterministic four inner folds formed by sorted sha256('TASK034:'+fire_id) round robin; inner mean saved hectares selects config; ties choose listed order; then refit outer97. Inner and outer heldout rewards used only after actions. Report all methods and both damage modes.
uncertainty: descriptive paired bootstrap of fixed OOF effects, 10000 samples seed0, no refit; shared folds and prior TRAIN reuse prevent independent confirmation
input_audit: all98: checksums, recomputed initial pooled channels, four observed weather records, masks/time/budget, fuel encoding aliases, initial nonfuel front and planned-line nonfuel coverage; synthetic witnesses for pooled front-position alias and fuel13/nonfuel alias

native_audit.cases: lexicographically first TRAIN fire and TRAIN fire with largest existing ADR034 no-op damage (tie by ID); diagnostic selection, not a representative sample
native_audit.interpretation: sensitivity diagnostic only; alternative dynamics are not re-calibrated, not candidate policy findings and do not replace ADR031/032

stop_conditions: new correctness defect affecting the finite table: stop scoring and document repair/rerun requirement
fixed menu exhausted: no tuning until success
transition_review: inventory confirmed bugs, passed checks, known simulator assumptions, untested possibilities and costs; recommend next step from evidence. Do not claim all possible bugs excluded or start CA training automatically.
